verdict.rationale: The DGX B300 is an on-prem system that ships with DGX OS and a management stack (BMC, Redfish, IPMI), so whether a user can opt out of telemetry is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents telemetry collection, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Self-encrypting drives and BMC management are adjacent features, not telemetry controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
